body:

Helper 1182 passes that gate but its full low exterior donor rank is two, increasing to three when the required column is appended. Both rational replays agree on all eight sites. Zero cases remain unresolved within this geometry.

The edit would fuse one paid public rank pair with the other routes and productive fields fixed. The directed one-edit upper was 0.118078219359 raw before additional costs. The eight-bank support result gives zero compatible saving for this exact scope.

The replay authenticates inputs and exact predecessor receipts, rebuilds the stock price, independently reproduces all eight dispositions, and rejects altered geometry and rank stock. The optional navigation suite has one baseline failure because main's CI guide still refers to #6030 after #7000 selection. The package-only diff leaves those files untouched.
